name: UPL Limited
summary: UPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pesticides, insecticides, and micronutrients in India, Brazil, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Crop protection, Seeds & Post-Harvest solutions, and Non-Agro segments. The company offers herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, acaricides, seed treatment, adjuvants, bio-solutions, public health products, fumigants, soil and water technologies, agrochemical products, and other agricultural related products under the Winger, Preview, Propose, and Nuvita brand names, as well as ProNutiva, a solution for crop protection.
